setType.description: The type of the training set, i.e. REP_BASED or TIME_BASED.

speed.description: Set speed in metres/feet per second

child.description: The child node in the category hierarchy tree

activityId.description: The id of the activity. It is inheriting the Monolith GeneralExercise Activity id

activityParentId.description: The id of the parent activity. Can be null

muscleMapping.description: A mapping between the different muscles to a percentage that says how much those muscles are involved in the activity

difficulty.description: How hard is it to do this activity. Currently this describes the minimum fitness level required

met.description: The MET value of this activity

bodyWeightRatio.description: Body/Weight ratio attribute of the activity

rangeOfMotion.description: Range OF Motion attribute of the activity

multiJoint.description: Indicates if the exercise requires single or multiple joints to do

status.description: Describes if this activity active or not

name.description: A map between the language code and the name. Key is the language code, Value is the name of the activity

description.description: A map between the language code and the description. Key is the language code, Value is the description

images.description: List with URLs containing the location of the images

videos.description: List with URLs containing the location of the images. Must be ordered from first to last

previews.description: List with URLs containing the location of the images. Must be ordered from first to last

availableForMaxStrengthTests.description: Whether or not the exercise _can_ be used as a manual max strength test

recommendedForMuscleImbalance.description: Whether or not the exercise _should_ be used as a manual max strength test for the purposes of calculating muscle imbalance

strengthBenchmarkMale.description: The male strength benchmark that will be applied to the user's weight to calculate the recommended weight for this exercise

strengthBenchmarkFemale.description: The female strength benchmark that will be applied to the user's weight to calculate the recommended weight for this exercise

calculationMethod.description: The method used to calculate the moved weight for this exercise

maxStrengthTestBodyRegion.description: The body region this exercise contributes to for the purposes of analyses based on max strength tests, eg Bio Age

manuallyTracked.description: Indicates whether this exercise is manually tracked or not (machine exercise)

updatedAt.description: When was this activity updated last

equipments.description: A list of equipments used for this activity

equipmentsV2.description: A list of equipments v2 used for this activity

clientMetadata.description: The client metadata field for this activity. Is persisted without interpretation

ownerId.description: Owner id string mainly used for elastic entities representation

laterality.description: Defines the laterality of the activity. Unilateral, bilateral or not applicable.

exerciseResistanceRelation.description: Total Resistance Benchmark (without calibration and display standard)

executionGuidance.description: Defines the execution guidance of the activity. Repetition based or pure time based.

executionForm.description: Defines the execution form of the activity. Plyometric, dynamic, explosive, static.

stability.description: Defines the stability of the activity. Stable or unstable.

cognitiveDemand.description: Defines the cognitive demand of the activity. Low, medium, high.

additionalUseCases.description: Defines additional use cases of the activity. Corrective, warmup, recovery, cooldown.

equipmentType.description: The type of equipment, it should be uppercase, only letters, only contains 'underscore' as separator between the words an it shouldn't start or end with 'underscore'

duration.description: Duration of the heart rate zone (in milliseconds).

orderNumber.description: The order number of the exercise, used for sorting.

sprint3Score.description: Matrix Sprint 3 Sweat Score. Value of -99 means this Sprint was skipped.

sprint4Score.description: Matrix Sprint 4 Sweat Score. Value of -99 means this Sprint was skipped.

sprint7Score.description: Matrix Sprint 7 Sweat Score. Value of -99 means this Sprint was skipped.

sprint8Score.description: Matrix Sprint 8 Sweat Score. Value of -99 means this Sprint was skipped.

programLevel.description: Matrix Sprint 8 Program Level. Range of non-negative integers.

deletable.description: If true then exercise can be deleted

Connected app technical name for connected app exercise. Can be one the following value or other opaque string:
fitbit, mmf, samsungHealth, appleHealth, strava, garmin, misfit, precor, polar, mb, mfp, hg, withings,
 tomtom, up, moves, suunto
